rebuttal_or_critique: I must express my strong disagreement with the proposal to shift to a neutral stance. While core inflation has moderated to 3.25%, headline CPI at 4.85% remains uncomfortably above our 4.00% target. The persistence of food inflation at 8.52% is not merely a supply-side nuisance; it is a potent risk that threatens to unanchor inflation expectations, which are the bedrock of price stability. With a positive output gap of 0.40% and Brent crude oil prices elevated at $90.45 per barrel, the economy is operating with limited slack. A premature shift to a neutral stance would signal a dilution of our commitment to the inflation target at a time when vigilance is paramount. We must maintain the withdrawal of accommodation to ensure that the disinflationary process is durable and not derailed by transient food price shocks or external spillovers.
